description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Data Structures and Algorithms topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: dsa

facts.claim: Big O gives an upper bound on the growth rate

source.quote: only provides an upper bound on the growth rate of the function

facts.claim: It classifies functions by growth rate as n becomes large
facts.pattern: growth rate|rate of growth|large (inputs?|n)|as n (increases|grows|becomes large)

source.quote: Binary search runs in logarithmic time in the worst case
